calls.title: Prerak Dali and August Allard
calls.summary: The session aimed to simulate a customer support interaction to address a data flow issue from GrowthBook to Google Analytics 4. Key problems identified included an SDK logging issue and an API key misconfiguration, both impacting data accuracy. Prerak demonstrated using Claude AI to validate the hypothesis regarding missing GTag snippets necessary for data forwarding. The team engaged in collaborative role-playing exercises to enhance support communication and troubleshooting skills while focusing on a structured workflow that emphasizes hypothesis testing and clear customer acknowledgment. They also discussed the importance of multi-timezone coverage and effective escalation protocols for ensuring seamless operations.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, SDK, Google Analytics 4, GA4, troubleshooting, client key, support collaboration
calls.action_items:
**Prerak Dali**
Provide an improved SDK code snippet to the customer to enable GA4 data flow based on troubleshooting results (18:30)
Suggest the customer replace the placeholder client key in the SDK configuration with the real client key from the GrowthBook dashboard (26:00)

**August Allard**
Implement the suggested SDK changes shared by Prerak and report back on the data flow result (20:30)
Locate the real client key in the GrowthBook dashboard and update the SDK configuration accordingly (28:30)
Send screenshots or additional details of errors for troubleshooting as needed (23:00)

**Kevin Chant**
Assist with clarifying the client key role and SDK configuration during troubleshooting (23:00)
Verify the status page and infrastructure for the reported incident on Sunday/Monday and clarify the outage situation (43:30)

**Natasha Lee**
Facilitate role playing and customer conversation simulation; prompt further info requests as needed (09:30)

**August Allard & Team**
Follow up with Prerak by early next week regarding recruitment/process outcome (48:20)
Respond to any additional questions from Prerak sent by email post-meeting (47:40)
